AbuseScenario: Fake organization onboarding for fraudulent issuance
Gaps: Identity proofing depth and KYB rigor may be inconsistent
PreventiveControls: Enhanced institution/employer proofing checklist + manual secondary verification before approval
DetectionSignals: Spike in new org accounts from shared infrastructure + later issuance activity
ImmediateContainment: Suspend applicant account and hold related credentials

AbuseScenario: Institution insider creates/edits students for identity abuse
Gaps: Need stronger anomaly controls for bulk/atypical profile edits
PreventiveControls: Step-up for bulk operations and high-risk profile fields + maker-checker for large batches
DetectionSignals: Unusual creation volume and repeated edits by one operator
ImmediateContainment: Freeze institution student-management actions pending review

AbuseScenario: QR token leakage and unauthorized first-consume verification
ExistingControls: Single-use token hash + TTL + atomic consume
Gaps: Tokens exposed in URLs/browser history/referrer channels
PreventiveControls: Warning banner + shortest viable TTL + no-referrer policy on verify pages
DetectionSignals: High invalid/used outcomes after generation for same credential
ImmediateContainment: Invalidate active tokens for credential and alert student

AbuseScenario: QR document token abuse for exfiltration
ExistingControls: One-time doc token + preview/download flags + TTL
Gaps: Download enablement may be overused and hard to supervise
PreventiveControls: Step-up confirmation when enabling download + stricter default to preview-only
DetectionSignals: Repeated doc token failures and unusual IP dispersion
ImmediateContainment: Disable document sharing for affected credential and rotate token flow

PreventiveControls: Route-class aware distributed limits + token/IP reputation checks
DetectionSignals: Request-rate spikes + low success ratio + repeated malformed tokens
ImmediateContainment: Activate emergency throttling profile and block offending IP ranges

Gaps: No dedicated anti-spam heuristics per actor/tenant
PreventiveControls: Adaptive per-user and per-tenant request quotas + cool-down windows
DetectionSignals: High request-create bursts with repeated rejection outcomes
ImmediateContainment: Temporarily suspend request creation for offending actor

AbuseScenario: Privilege abuse via admin role/status changes
Gaps: High-impact actions need stronger transaction-level controls
PreventiveControls: Step-up auth + dual authorization for high-risk role transitions
DetectionSignals: Role-change followed by issuance/status-change chain anomalies
ImmediateContainment: Revoke admin session/tokens and freeze admin mutations

AbuseScenario: Internal endpoint misuse when service token is absent/weak
Gaps: Middleware currently allows pass-through when token config is missing
PreventiveControls: Fail-closed internal auth policy + startup hard-fail on missing token
DetectionSignals: Any call to internal endpoint without known service identity
ImmediateContainment: Block internal routes at gateway and rotate service secrets

ExistingControls: MIME allow-list + size limits + encryption at rest
Gaps: MIME checks alone can be bypassed; no deep file validation noted
PreventiveControls: Magic-byte validation + malware scan pipeline + PDF safety profile
DetectionSignals: Upload failure bursts and suspicious mime/extension mismatches
ImmediateContainment: Quarantine recent uploads and pause issuance for affected tenant

AbuseScenario: Audit evasion or insufficient forensic traceability
Gaps: Missing correlation IDs and possible token leakage in logs
PreventiveControls: Correlation-ID propagation + log redaction policy + integrity controls
DetectionSignals: Events without trace linkage across gateway/services
